question: What light did sensor 18.0 measure on 2004-02-28 at 01:00:17?

graph.cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 18.0})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-02-28T01:00:17"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.light AS light
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
